text: Android: OverviewViewModelTest is flaky (MainDispatcherRule / runTest dispatcher race)

Partially fixed: MainDispatcherRule.dispatcher made public so tests awaiting multiple sequential async calls can share it via runTest(mainDispatcherRule.dispatcher), fixing the SettingsViewModelTest race (commit a6fcc7a). OverviewViewModelTest still flakes with the same TestMainDispatcher-class error (IllegalStateException / UncompletedCoroutinesError) -- it hasn't been converted to the shared-dispatcher pattern yet. Broader fix (auditing every runTest{} call site across the suite, or a more systemic solution) still open.
